# Ginga Global Group

Ginga Global Group (GGG) is a Sydney-based football talent management and development agency founded and operated by Theo Vassilikopoulos, with Technical Director Marcos Bezerra. GGG identifies, develops, and represents football players across Sydney, Melbourne, and Adelaide — connecting players to international trials, representative tournaments, elite training camps, and club pathways. The agency is family-run and boutique, working directly with players and families rather than through intermediaries. GGG has organised over 10 international tours taking more than 500 players and parents to Spain, Brazil, Thailand, and England. GGG also manages the Australian squad for the Elite Neon Cup in Athens, Greece, a recruitment pathway for Greek-heritage NPL-level players.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gingaglobalgroup.com/) — Overview of GGG's talent management services, current programs (Elite Neon Cup Athens 2027), and latest blog posts.
- [About](https://gingaglobalgroup.com/about) — Agency background, team profiles for Theo Vassilikopoulos (Owner/Founder) and Marcos Bezerra (Technical Director), and player success stories including William Vassilikopoulos and Tiago Armaleo.
- [Programs](https://gingaglobalgroup.com/programs) — Overview of all GGG programs: Elite Neon Cup Athens 2027 (active), Brazil Tour (past), Thailand Tour (past).
- [Services](https://gingaglobalgroup.com/services) — Player development and scouting, club and coach connections, elite international tours.
- [Blog](https://gingaglobalgroup.com/blog) — Tour reports, player stories, and news. Posts are categorised by series (e.g. AMF U20 Futsal World Cup Spain 2024).
- [Contact](https://gingaglobalgroup.com/contact) — Email: info@gingaglobalgroup.com. Phone: +61 414 580 591. Based in Sydney, Australia.
- [Elite Neon Cup](https://gingaglobalgroup.com/elite-neon-cup) — International youth football tournament in Athens, Greece. GGG selects and manages the Australian squad. Eligibility: born 2011 or 2013, NPL-level, Greek heritage (player, parent or grandparent), based in Sydney, Melbourne or Adelaide. Registration open.
- [CBFC Trials](https://gingaglobalgroup.com/cbfc-trials) — Canterbury Bankstown FC JDL trials for U9–U12 players in Sydney, run by Ginga Global Group as a partner club initiative.

## Key People

**Theo Vassilikopoulos** — Owner and Founder of Ginga Global Group. Also serves as General Manager at Soccer de Brazil (Australia), President of Brisbane Elitefoot Futsal Club, Vice President of the Federation of Australian Futsal, and President of Canterbury Bankstown Futsal Club. Team Manager for Australia's U13 and U20 national futsal teams at recent Futsal World Cups. Has organised over 10 international tours for more than 500 players and parents across Spain, Brazil, Thailand and England.

**Marcos Bezerra** — Technical Director at Ginga Global Group. Leads player development, working with athletes on the technical skills and readiness required to advance to the next stage of their football pathway.
